description.en-US: The poems of St. John of the Cross in the English verse of the 1912-1919 Lewis/Zimmerman volume (the Dark Night, the Song of the Soul and the Bridegroom, the Living Flame, the Ecstasy, the Creation, the Incarnation, Super Flumina Babylonis and others, with a second group of translations of the Spanish songs). The English is a different selection and division from Silverio's Spanish Poesias, so it is its own book. Verse translators are not named in the scan's poems section.
description.pt-BR: Os poemas de São João da Cruz em verso inglês, do volume de Lewis e Zimmerman (1912-1919).

en-US.translator: Various (David Lewis and Benedict Zimmerman edition)

sources.edition: The Living Flame of Love, with his Letters, Poems and Minor Writings, translated by David Lewis, with corrections and an introduction by Benedict Zimmerman, O.C.D., London: Thomas Baker, 1919 (first edition 1912). sources.description: Poems section of the volume, pp. 251-310. The scan is the best of the three; page headings, page numbers and footnotes are dropped, line-break hyphens joined, and isolated recognition slips may remain.
